11.—(1) In meeting its responsibilities under this Act, an
organisation must consider what a reasonable person would
consider appropriate in the circumstances.
(2) An organisation is responsible for personal data in its possession
or under its control.
(3) An organisation must designate one or more individuals to be
responsible for ensuring that the organisation complies with this Act.
(4) An individual designated under subsection (3) may delegate to
another individual the responsibility conferred by that designation.
(5) An organisation must make available to the public the business
contact information of at least one of the individuals designated under
subsection (3) or delegated under subsection (4).
(5A) Without limiting subsection (5), an organisation is deemed to
have satisfied that subsection if the organisation makes available the
business contact information of any individual mentioned in
subsection (3) in any prescribed manner.
[40/2020]
(6) The designation of an individual by an organisation under
subsection (3) does not relieve the organisation of any of its
obligations under this Act.

misses.original_text:
Article 43
Le responsable d’un traitement ne peut transférer des données à caractère personnel
vers un Etat étranger que si cet Etat assure un niveau de protection suffisant de la vie
privée et des libertés et droits fondamentaux des personnes à l’égard du traitement
dont ces données font l’objet ou peuvent faire l’objet.
Le caractère suffisant du niveau de protection assuré par un Etat s’apprécie
notamment en fonction des dispositions en vigueur dans cet Etat, des mesures de
sécurité qui y sont appliquées, des caractéristiques propres du traitement telles que
ses fins et sa durée, ainsi que de la nature, de l’origine et de la destination des
données traitées.

alinéas 1 et 2 ci-dessus.

unsupported.conclusion: 在个人同意或转移为履行合同所必需等情形下，若接收方受法律可执行义务约束提供可比保护标准，组织视为满足采取适当步骤的要求。
unsupported.quote:
19.3 An organisation transferring personal data overseas is taken to have satisfied the
requirement to take appropriate stepsto ensure that the recipient is bound by legally
enforceable obligations to provide to the personal data transferred a standard of
protection that is comparable to that under the PDPA if:
a) subject to conditions, the individual whose personal data is to be
transferred gives his consent to the transfer of his personal data34;
b) the transfer is necessary for the performance of a contract between the
organisation and the individual (for example, if the organisation is a data
intermediary of the individual pursuant to a contract between them in
relation to the transfer), or to do anything at the individual’s request with a
view to his entering a contract with the organisation;
unsupported.reason: 引文虽支持同意或合同必需等情形下视为满足适当步骤要求，但结论省略了同意须“受条件约束”、合同须为组织与个人之间合同、以及为个人订立合同目的应其请求行事等限定，范围可能过宽。

unsupported.conclusion: 相关数据保护条款不施加义务于个人或家庭目的的个人、受雇履行职务的雇员、公共机构及规定的其他组织或数据；企业是否受约束取决于是否落入排除范围。
unsupported.quote:
Application of Act
4.—(1) Parts 3, 4, 5, 6, 6A and 6B do not impose any obligation
on —
(a) any individual acting in a personal or domestic capacity;
(b) any employee acting in the course of his or her
employment with an organisation;
(c) any public agency; or
(d) any other organisations or personal data, or classes of
organisations or personal data, prescribed for the purposes
of this provision.
unsupported.reason: 引文列明个人/家庭目的者、雇员、公共机构及规定的其他组织或数据不受相关条款义务约束，但未直接表述“企业是否受约束取决于是否落入排除范围”，该最后分句属于推断。

unsupported.conclusion: 对组织违法处理个人数据可处财务处罚，上限按年度营业额分档：营业额超过$10 million的，为在新加坡年度营业额的10%；其他情形为$1 million。
unsupported.quote:
Section 48J of the principal Act, as inserted by section 23, is
amended —
(a) by deleting subsection (3) and substituting the following
subsection:
“(3) A financial penalty imposed on an organisation
under subsection (1)(a) must not exceed the
maximum amount to be prescribed, which in no
case may be more than the following:
(a) in the case of a contravention on or after the
date of commencement of section 24 of the
Personal Data Protection (Amendment)
Act 2020 by an organisation whose
annual turnover in Singapore exceeds
$10 million — 10% of the annual
turnover in Singapore of the organisation;
(b) in any other case — $1 million.”;
unsupported.reason: 引文仅支持在2020年修正案第24条生效日或之后违法的组织适用10%营业额上限；结论未包含该时间条件，故不完全支持。

unsupported.conclusion: 对个人违法处理个人数据可处财务处罚，上限为$200,000；对年度营业额超过$20 million的人，为在新加坡年度营业额的5%；其他情形为$1 million。
unsupported.quote:
(c) by inserting, immediately after subsection (4), the
following subsection:
“(4A) A financial penalty imposed on a person
under subsection (1)(b)(ii) must not exceed the
maximum amount to be prescribed, which in no
case may be more than the following:
(a) in the case of an individual — $200,000;
(b) in the case of a contravention on or after the
date of commencement of section 24 of the
Personal Data Protection (Amendment)
Act 2020 by a person whose annual
turnover in Singapore exceeds
$20 million — 5% of the annual turnover
of the person in Singapore;
(c) in any other case — $1 million.”;
unsupported.reason: 引文对超过$20 million营业额者的5%上限仅适用于2020年修正案第24条生效日或之后的违法；结论未包含该时间条件，故不完全支持。

unsupported.conclusion: 试验开始前必须取得相关授权；主管机构可对试验及每辆自动驾驶汽车施加条款和条件。
unsupported.quote:
For the purpose of the Trial, the relevant authorisation under the Road Traffic
(Autonomous Motor Vehicles) Rules 2017 (“Authorisation”) must be granted before the
Trial can commence. Terms and conditions may be imposed on the conduct of the Trial,
and LTA may impose terms and conditions in respect of each AV to be used in the Trial.
unsupported.reason: 引文明确支持“试验开始前须取得授权”及LTA可就每辆自动驾驶汽车施加条款和条件；但对试验本身施加条款和条件一句未明确主体，结论将两者均归于主管机构，略有补充。

unsupported.conclusion: 组织应采取安全安排，防止个人数据被未经授权访问、收集、使用、披露、复制、修改或处置等风险，并防止存储介质或设备丢失。
unsupported.quote:
security arrangements to prevent (i) unauthorised access, collection, use,
disclosure, copying, modification or disposal, or similar risks; and (ii) the loss
of any storage medium or device on which personal data is stored.
unsupported.reason: 引文支持防止所列未经授权访问、收集、使用、披露、复制、修改、处置等风险以及存储介质或设备丢失，但未明确出现“组织应采取”的义务主体和义务表述，故未完整支持结论。

unsupported.conclusion: 安全安排可采取行政措施、物理措施、技术措施或多种措施组合，以保护个人数据。
unsupported.quote:
17.5 Security arrangements may take various forms such as administrative measures,
physical measures, technical measures or a combination of these. The following
tables list examples of such measures.
unsupported.reason: 引文完整支持安全安排可采取行政、物理、技术措施或其组合，但未明确提及“以保护个人数据”这一目的，故仅部分支持。

unsupported.conclusion: 本法适用于控制者设在摩洛哥的个人数据处理；在摩洛哥开展活动即视为设立；非设在摩洛哥但为处理使用境内自动化或非自动化手段的也适用，仅过境或等效立法国家除外。
unsupported.quote:
2- La présente loi s’applique au traitement des données à caractère personnel
répondant à la définition du paragraphe 1 ci-dessus :
a) Lorsqu’il est effectué par une personne physique ou morale dont le
responsable est établi sur le territoire marocain. Le responsable d’un
traitement qui exerce une activité sur le territoire marocain dans le
cadre d’une installation, qu’elle que soit sa forme juridique, y est
considéré comme établi ;
b) Lorsque le responsable n’est pas établi sur le territoire marocain mais
recourt, à des fins de traitement des données à caractère personnel, à
des moyens automatisés ou non, situés sur le territoire marocain, à
l’exclusion des traitements qui ne sont utilisés qu’à des fins de transit sur
le territoire national ou sur celui d’un Etat dont la législation est
reconnue équivalente à celle du Maroc en matière de protection des
données à caractère personnel ;
unsupported.reason: 结论大体符合引文，但引文要求控制者在摩洛哥“通过某种设施开展活动”才视为设立，结论仅称“在摩洛哥开展活动即视为设立”，遗漏了设施/安装条件，范围略有扩大。

unsupported.conclusion: 为遵守法律义务、履行合同或先合同措施、保护无法同意的当事人重大利益、执行公共任务或行使公共权力、或实现合法利益且不侵害当事人权利自由所必需时，无须取得同意。
unsupported.quote:
Toutefois, ce consentement n’est pas exigé si le traitement est nécessaire :
a) au respect d’une obligation légale à laquelle est soumis la personne
concernée ou le responsable du traitement ;
